anacorp-ana-corp:lever:9b414068-80b2-404.description: About ANA: Join a recognized industry leader - Alliance North America was proudly named a 2025 Top Workplace in the Manufacturing Industry, an honor based entirely on feedback from our own employees about our culture, values, and workplace experience. Alliance North America was established in 2017 and is proud to be the sole North American supplier of AIRMAN Power Generators, AIRMAN Air Compressors, and ANA’s patented EBOSS® Hybrid Energy System and Smart Load Bank System. Our commitment to our customers is to Make their World Easier, by answering the phone, understanding their needs, and taking ownership to provide them solutions. With a large parts inventory and more than 90% of all orders shipping within 24 hours, you never have to worry about spare parts. We help keep your fleet in top condition with our world class Support Department, who are always ready to help and be a resource by providing training on our equipment. ANA is headquartered in Henderson, Nevada, with locations in Cypress, California, and Spartanburg, South Carolina. ANA is growing and scaling, and we are seeking a Buyer II to join our growing team in an on-site position in Henderson, Nevada. As a Buyer II, you will manage complex purchasing categories and supplier relationships. This role balances transactional and tactical responsibilities — executing purchases, analyzing spend data, negotiating pricing, and supporting cost-saving initiatives. The Buyer II acts with limited supervision and contributes to process improvements and supplier management. This position is fully onsite, and the work schedule is weekdays from 8:00 am – 5:00 pm. This role reports to the Purchasing Manager.

assistworld-assist-world:lever:bc1e01b7-.title: Patient Coordinator / Front Desk VA
assistworld-assist-world:lever:bc1e01b7-.description: About the Role The client runs an outpatient surgery center where physicians schedule and perform minor outpatient procedures. This VA will support the administrative side of patient intake and provider coordination — keeping charts complete, records organized in the EMR, and communication flowing smoothly between the office, providers, and patients. Key Responsibilities • Assemble patient charts by uploading required paperwork (from digital fax and email) into the electronic medical record (EMR). • Create new patient accounts in the EMR and keep records up to date. • Review each patient's file against a standard checklist and flag any missing documents before a scheduled procedure. • Coordinate with physicians' offices to compile scheduling details and paperwork for blocks of scheduled cases. • Handle correspondence between providers, partner offices, and the surgery center via email. • Answer and route incoming calls (via OpenPhone/Zoom Voice) and communicate professionally with patients and providers. • Support ongoing efforts to bring more AI-driven tools into daily workflows. What We're Looking For • 3+ years of experience in a front desk, patient coordinator, or medical administrative role. • Tech-savvy and comfortable learning new electronic systems and EMR platforms (prior EMR experience is a plus, not required). • Some experience using AI tools, or enthusiasm for learning and helping implement them. • Sharp, adaptable, and able to make good judgment calls — knows when to solve independently and when to ask for help. • Comfortable and confident communicating by phone, email, and Zoom. • Able to work full-time, Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time. Nice to Have • Bilingual in Spanish, or fluency in a Filipino/Asian language (the practice sees a meaningful number of Filipino and Asian patients). • Based in the Philippines (slight preference given patient demographics, not a requirement).

blackwhitezebra-black-white-zebra:lever:.description: About The CFO Club: The CFO Club helps finance leaders navigate the complexity of modern finance so they can focus on strategic decision-making, capital efficiency, operational effectiveness, and long-term value creation. We provide peer-driven insights, practical frameworks, executive playbooks, and community-powered experiences that help CFOs and finance operators lead with greater clarity and confidence in a rapidly changing environment shaped by AI, evolving systems, and organizational complexity. Our audience includes CFOs, FP&A leaders, controllers, finance operators, and senior decision-makers looking for practical insight, trustworthy guidance, and meaningful professional connection. About the Role: We are looking for a Senior Editor to help build The CFO Club into a trusted, community-powered media brand for modern finance leaders. This role is responsible for growing loyal, engaged finance leadership audiences through authoritative, practitioner-led editorial experiences across articles, newsletters, social, video, podcasts, livestreams, events, and strategic partnerships. This is not a traditional editing role focused only on publishing content. It is an audience growth and editorial leadership role centered on creating serious-fun, decision-support content that helps finance leaders make better decisions, discover better tools and workflows, and navigate the changing realities of modern financial leadership. gendigital-gen-digital:ashbyhq:182a6be2-.description: ABOUT US: Gen is a global company dedicated to powering Digital Freedom through its trusted consumer brands including Norton, Avast, LifeLock, MoneyLion and more. Our combined heritage is rooted in financial empowerment and cyber safety for the first digital generations, and today we deliver award-winning cybersecurity, online privacy, identity protection and financial wellness solutions to nearly 500 million users in more than 150 countries. Together, we share a collective passion and vision to protect consumers and help them grow, manage and secure their digital and financial lives. We’re always looking for smart, fearless and high-impact talent who see AI as a teammate – leveraging it to move faster and deliver meaningful results. When you’re part of Gen, you’ll have the flexibility, tools and support to do your best work and grow your career – from flexible working options and time off to competitive pay, benefits and well-being programs. At Gen, we are scrappy and relentlessly customer driven. We create room for healthy debate, experimentation and continuous learning, and we seek out people with different experiences, identities and ideas to join our team. You’ll work with people who back each other, respect each other and understand that our differences are a competitive advantage. If this sounds like you, we’d love you to be part of Gen. ABOUT THE ROLE: As a Manager on the Security Engineering team at Gen, you will lead the Data Integrity & Security Analytics function, managing a team of engineers responsible for core security services that improve trust in enterprise data, strengthen control visibility and support risk-based security decisions. Working closely with Security, Infrastructure, Platform and Engineering teams, you will provide both people leadership and technical direction for capabilities spanning security analytics, data integrity and data protection services, including encryption and certificate lifecycle management. You'll be responsible for delivering reliable, scalable services while driving operational excellence, continuous improvement and measurable security outcomes across the enterprise. We're looking for a collaborative engineering leader who enjoys developing high-performing teams, improving engineering practices and leveraging AI responsibly to enhance analytics, automation and operational efficiency. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: - Lead, mentor and develop a team of security engineers, fostering a collaborative environment where team members can grow and succeed. - Own the delivery, operational maturity and continuous improvement of Data Integrity & Security Analytics capabilities. - Oversee services supporting security analytics, data integrity, encryption and certificate lifecycle management. - Define and improve metrics, dashboards and reporting that provide visibility into control health, operational performance, data quality and security risk. - Drive automation and engineering best practices to improve scalability, reliability, consistency and policy enforcement. - Identify opportunities to leverage AI-enabled tools to improve analytics, reporting and team productivity. - Partner with Security, Infrastructure, Platform and Engineering teams to integrate security controls and analytics into enterprise platforms and workflows. - Establish documentation, operating procedures and support models that improve resilience, maintainability and accountability. - Support audit, compliance and regulatory requirements through strong service ownership and measurable control outcomes. ABOUT YOU: - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. - Experience leading and developing engineering teams within a complex enterprise environment. - Strong background in Security Engineering, Infrastructure Security, Platform Engineering or a related technical discipline. - Solid understanding of data integrity, security analytics

jobgether-jobgether:lever:f9e64fda-de07-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Front-End UI/UX Engineer based in France. This role is an opportunity to shape intuitive, accessible, and high-quality digital experiences for complex enterprise applications. You will combine strong front-end engineering expertise with a deep understanding of UI/UX and accessibility principles. Working primarily within an ASP.NET MVC 5 environment, you will translate business and user needs into polished, maintainable interfaces. Your work will help ensure applications are usable, inclusive, responsive, and compliant with modern accessibility standards. You will collaborate closely with business stakeholders, customers, designers, QA specialists, and technology teams. The position offers a hands-on engineering environment where you can influence both technical implementation and the overall user experience. You will also contribute to technical specifications, testing, documentation, and the delivery of reliable production-ready solutions. Design, develop, enhance, and maintain accessible, user-centered interfaces for complex enterprise applications built on ASP.NET MVC 5. Translate business requirements, user needs, and design concepts into clean, intuitive, maintainable, and production-ready front-end experiences. Apply UI/UX principles including information architecture, interaction design, visual hierarchy, usability, and responsive design to real-world applications. Implement and validate web accessibility in accordance with WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA and Section 508 requirements. Apply semantic HTML, ARIA roles and attributes, keyboard navigation, focus management, and other accessibility best practices. Test interfaces using assistive technologies and screen readers such as JAWS, NVDA, and VoiceOver, as appropriate. Develop and support full-stack .NET applications using C#, ASP.NET MVC 5, SQL Server, and related Microsoft technologies in a Windows environment. Build and integrate front-end experiences with RESTful APIs and internal or external systems. Work with Microsoft SQL Server, including data models, T-SQL queries, stored procedures, and views required to support application functionality. Prepare technical design specifications, technical documentation, and clear design documentation. Write and maintain unit tests while supporting QA, usability testing, accessibility validation, and release activities. Analyze requirements, troubleshoot complex UI and cross-browser issues, and deliver stable, polished solutions within established timelines. Collaborate with business stakeholders, customers, designers, and cross-functional technology teams to validate solutions and resolve issues. Contribute to design reviews, accessibility audits, usability initiatives, and continuous improvements to the application's user experience. Work independently within established enterprise codebases while identifying opportunities to modernize and improve legacy front-end components. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Human-Computer Interaction, Design, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 5–8+ years of professional software development experience, with significant hands-on experience in front-end and UI development. Strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and jQuery, with a focus on clean, semantic, maintainable markup. Demonstrated ability to apply UI/UX principles such as information architecture, interaction design, visual hierarchy, usability, and user-centered design. Hands-on experience implementing and testing accessible web experiences against WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA and Section 508 standards. Practical knowledge of ARIA, semantic HTML, keyboard navigation, focus management, and accessibility testing with assistive technologies. Strong proficiency in C# and ASP.NET MVC 5, with experience developing and supporting full-stack .NET applications in Windows env

You must be highly motivated, have an outgoing, and a friendly personality. We will provide extensive hands-on and online training for all team members. weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:943c9f2c-636.description: Description About the Project We're looking for native-level Spanish (Spain) speakers with professional voice recording experience to join the Hydrus Project. The project consists of two scheduled recording sessions from their own home studio. Because the recordings go straight into production, the audition validates two things equally: your voice and your recording environment. What You'll Do Audition with two 30 second samples using your home studio set up Once approved, you will complete two scheduled recording sessions of approximately 4 hours each Participate in natural conversation, prompted discussion, and scripted customer-service scenarios Record from your own home studio setup across both sessions Your Recording Environment Three things are required, and each is judged separately: An external microphone: A separate, dedicated microphone is absolutely required — see below. A dry room: Your voice should sound close and clear, with no echo or hollow, distant quality. Untreated rooms with bare walls, hard floors, and high ceilings usually fail. A quiet room: No HVAC hum, fans, traffic, appliances, or household noise during recording. Minimum Required Gear Dynamic Mics (best for untreated rooms): Shure SM58, Shure MV7 / MV7+, RODE PodMic / PodMic USB, or similar. Condenser mic (great in a treated room): RODE NT-USB Mini, Blue Yeti / Yeti Orb, Blue Bluebird, Blue Baby Bottle, or similar. Room Treatment: Your recording space should produce studio-quality sound samples – isolation shields, sounds absorbing pads, etc… Immediately rejected: built-in laptop microphones, phone mics, AirPods, Samsung Buds, headphone-attached mics, headsets, and gaming headsets. Technical Specification You must be able to produce audio samples in the meeting the following specifications: WAV format, 24-bit, 48 kHz, no compression. Free software such as Audacity can produce this. If you cannot export in this format, please do not apply — this level of technicality is required for this role. Who We're Looking For Native-level Spanish (Spain) speaker A natural, authentic, friendly, conversational customer-service speaking style A dry, quiet home recording space and a professional microphone, as described above Good background, but not required: Podcasters, youtubers, streamers, recording artists, voice-over actors, etc – anyone who has experience recording audio in a high-quality home studio Commitment & Compensation Estimated time: approximately 8 hours total across two scheduled sessions Compensation: $40.00 USD per hour
